d:
The Heat defeated the Pacers, 145-125 tonight in Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with a team-high 31 points along with 18 rebounds and 10 assists for the Heat, while Bam Adebayo tallied 27 points, 9 rebounds and 3 steals in the game. Quenton Jackson recorded 24 points, 4 rebounds and 2 steals. The Heat improve their record to 2-4 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 2-4 for the season.
